primary_sources.finding: Path.resolve makes a path absolute while resolving symbolic links; therefore symlink identity is not preserved in the returned resolved Path.
Regular-file predicates follow symbolic links while link predicates apply to the directory entry itself; testing a post-resolution path cannot recover a symlink component that was already traversed.
Linux exposes RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS specifically to reject symbolic links in any path component during resolution; final-component O_NOFOLLOW alone is not equivalent.

current_source_observation.finding: The route validator resolves the declared route before checking is_symlink(). An in-root symlink can therefore lose lexical link identity before the check. This is a source-level falsifier candidate, not yet a reproduced runtime failure.
